# Khaacho

Khaacho builds revenue intelligence tools for wholesale and industrial distributors.

## Primary product
Revenue Leak Finder helps distributors analyze historical sales data to identify:
- missed reorders
- declining or at-risk customer accounts
- cross-sell opportunities
- overdue receivables requiring attention

It is designed to work from existing CSV or Excel exports and does not require replacing an ERP or CRM for an initial audit.

## Initial offer
Revenue Leak Audit: USD 500 one-time validation engagement.

## Intended users
Wholesale and industrial distributors with repeat B2B purchasing and sales teams, including industrial/MRO, electrical, HVAC, janitorial, foodservice, automotive-parts and building-material distributors.

## Important URLs
Homepage: https://khaacho.com/
Live product demo: https://ai.studio/apps/56195ac5-d39a-44a6-a2cf-42fe81722b24
Contact: mailto:khaaaacho@gmail.com

## Claims and limitations
Opportunity values for reorders, account risk and cross-sell are modeled estimates based on historical data and are not guaranteed revenue. Outstanding receivables are treated separately from potential new revenue.
